records.jp: 陽桜莉、詩！
records.en_original: Hiori, Uta!
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori, Uta!
records.en: Hiori, Uta!

records.jp: お姉ちゃん……
records.en_original: Mio...
records.en_auxiliary: Mio...
records.en: Onee-chan...

records.jp: ……あなたたち、おかしいわ
records.en_original: I don't understand you two...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't understand you two...
records.en: I don't understand you two...

records.jp: 記憶を取り戻して、分かった。<CR>私とあなたたちは、慣れ合うような関係じゃない
records.en_original: I finally realized after recovering my memories. You and I will never understand each other.
records.en_auxiliary: I finally realized after recovering my memories. You and I will never understand each other.
records.en: I finally realized after recovering my memories. You and I will never understand each other.

records.jp: そうでしょう？
records.en_original: Isn't that right?
records.en_auxiliary: Isn't that right?
records.en: Isn't that right?

records.jp: ……ええ。そうだったかもしれないわね
records.en_original: ...Yes, that may very well have been the case.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yes, that may very well have been the case.
records.en: ...Yes, that may very well have been the case.

records.jp: 私は、あなたたちに<CR>許されていいような存在じゃない
records.en_original: My existence is something that you can't tolerate.
records.en_auxiliary: My existence is something that you can't tolerate.
records.en: My existence is something that you can't tolerate.

records.jp: 私が背負っているのは、<CR>そんなちんけな十字架じゃなかったはず
records.en_original: The cross I bear isn't something so easily solved.
records.en_auxiliary: The cross I bear isn't something so easily solved.
records.en: The cross I bear isn't something so easily solved.

records.jp: でも、あなたは変わりたいって思ってる
records.en_original: But I know that you want to change.
records.en_auxiliary: But I know that you want to change.
records.en: But I know that you want to change.

records.jp: それに、大きなクラックも起きなかった。<CR>約束を守った証拠は、この世界が証明している
records.en_original: Also, no Crack appeared. That is proof from this world that you kept your promise.
records.en_auxiliary: Also, no Crack appeared. That is proof from this world that you kept your promise.
records.en: Also, no Crack appeared. That is proof from this world that you kept your promise.

records.jp: そんな簡単な理由で許されて、いいわけが――
records.en_original: That alone shouldn't be enough to absolve me of—
records.en_auxiliary: That alone shouldn't be enough to absolve me of—
records.en: That alone shouldn't be enough to absolve me of—

records.jp: …………ああ、もう！！<CR>ごちゃごちゃめんどくさいなぁ！！
records.en_original: Enough! I'm tired of this!!
records.en_auxiliary: Enough! I'm tired of this!!
records.en: Enough! I'm tired of this!!

records.jp: ……えっ
records.en_original: ...What?
records.en_auxiliary: ...What?
records.en: ...What?

records.jp: じゃあもう一生許さない！！
records.en_original: Then I'll never forgive you!!
records.en_auxiliary: Then I'll never forgive you!!
records.en: Then I'll never forgive you!!

records.en_original: Wha—?!
records.en_auxiliary: Wha—?!
records.en: Wha—?!

records.jp: だから……一生かけて償って。<CR>みんなのために。私たちと一緒に
records.en_original: You can spend the rest of your life atoning for what you've done. Together with us.
records.en_auxiliary: You can spend the rest of your life atoning for what you've done. Together with us.
records.en: You can spend the rest of your life atoning for what you've done. Together with us.

records.en_original: *Sigh*...
records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh*...
records.en: *Sigh*...

records.jp: まったく、あなたたちは……
records.en_original: Unbelievable. All of you...
records.en_auxiliary: Unbelievable. All of you...
records.en: Unbelievable. All of you...

records.jp: 結局どこまで行っても、<CR>私に人の感情なんて分からないのね
records.en_original: It seems I'll never understand people's emotions no matter how hard I try.
records.en_auxiliary: It seems I'll never understand people's emotions no matter how hard I try.
records.en: It seems I'll never understand people's emotions no matter how hard I try.

records.jp: 今までの私を、簡単に捨てることなんてできない
records.en_original: I can't just abandon my old self behind so easily.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't just abandon my old self behind so easily.
records.en: I can't just abandon my old self behind so easily.

records.jp: ……ええ
records.en_original: ...Indeed.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Indeed.
records.en: ...Indeed.

records.jp: だから今も、心の中には……<CR>あの頃の私が変わらずに存在する
records.en_original: That part of me will always exist somewhere inside.
records.en_auxiliary: That part of me will always exist somewhere inside.
records.en: That part of me will always exist somewhere inside.

records.jp: すべてを壊せ、そうすれば気持ちよくなれる……<CR>そうやって、私が私に囁きかけてくる
records.en_original: It tries to tempt me, telling me just how good it would feel to destroy everything.
records.en_auxiliary: It tries to tempt me, telling me just how good it would feel to destroy everything.
records.en: It tries to tempt me, telling me just how good it would feel to destroy everything.

records.jp: でも……今はやめておく
records.en_original: But...I won't.
records.en_auxiliary: But...I won't.
records.en: But...I won't.

records.jp: そんなことをしている場合じゃないのは分かってる。<CR>私だって、このまま死にたいわけじゃない
records.en_original: I understand that now is not the time for that. I don't want to die like this.
records.en_auxiliary: I understand that now is not the time for that. I don't want to die like this.
records.en: I understand that now is not the time for that. I don't want to die like this.

records.jp: だから……もしこれが、償いになるのなら
records.en_original: So... If this is the way I can make amends to you all...
records.en_auxiliary: So... If this is the way I can make amends to you all...
records.en: So... If this is the way I can make amends to you all...

records.jp: かつての私が持っていた神との“つながり”――<CR>そこで見た景色を、皆さんにお話しします
records.en_original: I will share with you what I know. The connection with god I once had...
records.en_auxiliary: I will share with you what I know. The connection with god I once had...
records.en: I will share with you what I know. The connection with god I once had...

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.en_original: ...What?
records.en_auxiliary: ...What?
records.en: ...What?

records.en_original: Uta?
records.en_auxiliary: Uta?
records.en: Uta?

records.jp: ……あ？　いや、違う！<CR>今のは、勝手に！　私じゃない……！
records.en_original: No! That wasn't me! I didn't—!
records.en_auxiliary: No! That wasn't me! I didn't—!
records.en: No! That wasn't me! I didn't—!

records.jp: クソッ、邪魔するな……ッ！！
records.en_original: Damn you! Get out of my way!
records.en_auxiliary: Damn you! Get out of my way!
records.en: Damn you! Get out of my way!

records.jp: ああ、もう！　分かった！<CR>分かったからッ！　頭の中で喚くな！！
records.en_original: Argh, okay! I get it! Stop yelling in my head like that!
records.en_auxiliary: Argh, okay! I get it! Stop yelling in my head like that!
records.en: Argh, okay! I get it! Stop yelling in my head like that!

records.jp: う、詩ちゃん……？　大丈夫……？
records.en_original: U-Uta? Are you okay?
records.en_auxiliary: U-Uta? Are you okay?
records.en: U-Uta-chan? Are you okay?

records.jp: …………あなた、どっち？
records.en_original: Which one are you?
records.en_auxiliary: Which one are you?
records.en: Which one are you?

records.jp: ……どっちだと思いますか？
records.en_original: Which do you think?
records.en_auxiliary: Which do you think?
records.en: Which do you think?

records.jp: ――いえ、ごめんなさい。<CR>もう、自分でも分からないんです
records.en_original: No, I'm sorry. I don't really know myself.
records.en_auxiliary: No, I'm sorry. I don't really know myself.
records.en: No, I'm sorry. I don't really know myself.

records.jp: ただ……私はこの世界であったことを忘れていない。<CR>そして、元の世界の自分も……胸の中にいる
records.en_original: But what I do know is that I'll never forget the things that happened here. And that my old self is...somewhere inside me.
records.en_auxiliary: But what I do know is that I'll never forget the things that happened here. And that my old self is...somewhere inside me.
records.en: But what I do know is that I'll never forget the things that happened here. And that my old self is...somewhere inside me.

records.jp: それでいいんじゃないかな？
records.en_original: I don't think that's such a bad thing.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think that's such a bad thing.
records.en: I don't think that's such a bad thing.

records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: だって……今まで経験したこと、<CR>全部合わせて詩ちゃんでしょ？
records.en_original: All those things together, they're what make you, you.
records.en_auxiliary: All those things together, they're what make you, you.
records.en: Everything you've experienced together makes you Uta-chan, doesn't it?

records.jp: どっちかじゃない、どっちも本物の詩ちゃんだよ
records.en_original: It's not the old you and the new you, both of those things together are what make Uta.
records.en_auxiliary: It's not the old you and the new you, both of those things together are what make Uta.
records.en: It's not the old you and the new you, both of those things together are what make Uta-chan.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん……
records.en_original: Hiori...
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori...
records.en: Hiori-san...

records.jp: また、あなたたちを傷つけるかもしれませんよ
records.en_original: I may try to hurt you again one day, you know?
records.en_auxiliary: I may try to hurt you again one day, you know?
records.en: I may try to hurt you again one day, you know?

records.jp: その時は全力で止める
records.en_original: I'll stop you with everything I've got.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll stop you with everything I've got.
records.en: I'll stop you with everything I've got.

records.jp: ね？　だから、心配しないで？<CR>ほら～。仲良くしようよ！！
records.en_original: So don't worry so much! Let's all get along!
records.en_auxiliary: So don't worry so much! Let's all get along!
records.en: So don't worry so much! Let's all get along!

records.jp: いや、そんな急に仲良くなんて、<CR>無理です、気持ち悪い……
records.en_original: Gross, I don't know if we need to do that all of a sudden...
records.en_auxiliary: Gross, I don't know if we need to do that all of a sudden...
records.en: Gross, I don't know if we need to do that all of a sudden...

records.jp: あ～！　口悪いよ詩ちゃん！<CR>気持ち悪くない！　同じ仲間じゃん！
records.en_original: What do you mean, gross?! We're friends, aren't we?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you mean, gross?! We're friends, aren't we?
records.en: Ah! Watch your mouth, Uta-chan! It isn't gross! We're friends, aren't we?!

records.jp: ち、近いです！　来ないでください！！
records.en_original: D-don't come any closer! Get away from me!
records.en_auxiliary: D-don't come any closer! Get away from me!
records.en: D-don't come any closer! Get away from me!

records.jp: ちょ、なんでー！？　待ってよー！！
records.en_original: Aw, come on! Stop running away!
records.en_auxiliary: Aw, come on! Stop running away!
records.en: Aw, come on! Stop running away!

records.jp: …………これでよかったのかもしれないわね
records.en_original: Perhaps this is the best we could have hoped for.
records.en_auxiliary: Perhaps this is the best we could have hoped for.
records.en: Perhaps this is the best we could have hoped for.

records.jp: ふふっ。そうですね。<CR>駒川さんの隣に、陽桜莉さんがいてよかった
records.en_original: Hehe, I think you're right. I'm glad Uta has Hiori.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, I think you're right. I'm glad Uta has Hiori.
records.en: Hehe, I think you're right. I'm glad Komagawa-san has Hiori-san.

records.jp: これでようやく、<CR>みんなで同じ方向を向けた気がするね
records.en_original: It feels like we finally all have the same goal.
records.en_auxiliary: It feels like we finally all have the same goal.
records.en: It feels like we finally all have the same goal.

records.jp: うん。……じゃあ、詩さんの話を――
records.en_original: Yeah. Let's hear what Uta has to tell us then.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. Let's hear what Uta has to tell us then.
records.en: Yeah. Let's hear what Uta-san has to tell us then.

records.jp: 詩さーん　戻ってきてー
records.en_original: Uta! Come back!
records.en_auxiliary: Uta! Come back!
records.en: Uta! Come back!

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんにおわらています
records.en_original: I'm being chastised by Hiori.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm being chastised by Hiori.
records.en: I'm being chastised by Hiori-san.

records.jp: 追われています
records.en_original: Chased.
records.en_auxiliary: Chased.
records.en: Chased.

records.jp: あとで一緒に教室行くねー！
records.en_original: We'll meet you in the classroom!
records.en_auxiliary: We'll meet you in the classroom!
records.en: We'll meet you in the classroom!

records.jp: 楽しそうですね
records.en_original: Seems like they're having fun.
records.en_auxiliary: Seems like they're having fun.
records.en: Seems like they're having fun.

records.jp: ん、いいことじゃない
records.en_original: Yeah, I'm glad.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, I'm glad.
records.en: Yeah, I'm glad.

records.jp: <CLGR>詩<CLNR>のタレントに<CR>新たなタレントタイプが解放されました
records.en_original: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Uta's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en_auxiliary: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Uta's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Uta's<CLNR> Talents.
